english: After the glorious ascension of the Lord, then, which crushed the head of the devil's malice and lifted the minds of the faithful to contemplate the things of heaven, the holy apostles of our Lord and Saviour, gathered in one house with the blessed Mary his mother, put everything in common: no one said that anything was his own, but each possessed all things in charity, as the sacred record of the Acts of the Apostles tells. After this they were scattered through different regions to preach the word of God.

At last, when the blessed Mary had completed the course of this life and was now being called from the world, all the apostles gathered from their several regions to her house. And when they heard that she was to be taken up from the world, they kept watch with her together; and behold, the Lord Jesus came with his angels, and receiving her soul, he handed it to Michael the archangel, and departed. At daybreak the apostles lifted her body with the bier, laid it in a tomb, and guarded it, awaiting the coming of the Lord. And behold, the Lord stood by them again, and ordered the holy body he had taken up to be carried on a cloud into paradise: where now, her soul restored to her, she rejoices with his chosen ones and enjoys the good things of eternity, which will never come to an end.
title: The apostles and the blessed Mary (cap. 4)
